excerpt: Open-source private AI agent OS. Encrypted under your password. Local LLMs, 3D avatar. - oscova/oscova-agents
content_html:
Private AI agents. Encrypted by default.
For home and office, on hardware you own.

Website · Documentation

⭐ Star and watch Oscova so you never miss what's new:

  • New avatars for the Oscova Avatar Engine, the free 3D avatar app that gives your agent, or your own app, a face
  • New plugins for channels, tools, speech and models
  • Framework changes that plugin builders need to know about
  • Regular updates to the agent OS itself
oscova-intro-readme.mp4

Watch the intro on YouTube

What is Oscova Agents?

Oscova Agents is a private AI agent OS: your agents' chats, memory, instructions and settings are encrypted under a Vault Password only you hold. An Egress Audit shows every call that leaves your machine. It runs on hardware you own, at home or in the office, with local models such as Ollama. On Windows, the free Oscova Avatar Engine app gives your agent a realistic 3D avatar that speaks on your screen.

Agents run as durable services. They keep working on scheduled tasks while you sleep and answer from any browser on your network.

  • A realistic 3D face for any agent. The Oscova Avatar Engine is a free Windows app that renders the avatar on your own PC and speaks your agent's replies with lip sync. Give OpenClaw, Hermes Agent or any MCP agent a 3D avatar.
  • Confidential by design. Every agent's chats, tool calls, task runs and memory are encrypted on disk under your Vault Password. Incognito chats never touch disk.
  • Local by default. Run local models such as Ollama, LLamaSharp and Foundry Local. Cloud providers are opt-in, and the Egress Audit lists every moment data left the machine.
  • No telemetry. Oscova sends no usage statistics and no crash reports.
  • Token-frugal. The runtime keeps prompts lean, so small local models still do real work.
  • Yours to edit. Every system and runtime instruction can be read and changed.
  • One box for the household or office. Each person gets their own sign-in, agents, tasks and conversations, with roles and per-agent tool control.

Features

Area What you get
Models Ollama, LLamaSharp (GGUF), Microsoft Foundry Local, and opt-in cloud providers
Voice Offline Whisper recognition and Kokoro synthesis, plus optional ElevenLabs and OpenAI speech
Avatar Oscova Avatar Engine: a separate Windows app that renders realistic Unreal Engine avatars on your PC, with lip sync and subtitles. Browser streaming needs extra setup
Channels Discord, Telegram and Slack private chats
Workspace Gmail, Google Calendar and YouTube. Outlook mail and Microsoft To Do
Tools Web and news search, a visible browser, MCP servers, skills and file tools
Execution Docker sandboxing and Microsoft MXC operating-system containment for shell commands
Automation Scheduled and triggered tasks, agent templates, notifications

Install Oscova on Windows, macOS or Linux

Oscova runs on Windows, macOS and Linux and needs the .NET 10 SDK. The installer offers to install .NET 10 when it is needed. Automatic .NET setup on Linux currently supports Ubuntu 24.04.

Windows (PowerShell)

irm https://oscova.ai/install.ps1 | iex

macOS and Linux

curl -fsSL https://oscova.ai/install.sh | bash

Or install the oscova CLI directly with .NET:

dotnet tool install --global Oscova.Agents.App

Then start Oscova:

oscova start

The Avatar Engine currently runs on Windows. Install it with oscova avatar install. Update Oscova with dotnet tool update --global Oscova.Agents.App.

See the documentation for setup, agents, tasks, privacy and administration.

What is in this repository

Oscova is open source: the framework and plugins under Apache-2.0, the app under AGPL-3.0. The main branch holds the agent framework that Oscova is built on and its official plugins, updated with every release. The app's source follows on the app branch, sometimes a while after a release. The Oscova Avatar Engine is a free, closed-source Windows app.

Every release passes thousands of automated tests, run internally, including end-to-end browser tests.

Project Purpose
Oscova.Agents Agent framework and plugin contract, built on the Microsoft Agent Framework
Agent Templates Editable starter agents for research, writing, planning and email
Browser Visible browser navigation, page reading and interaction
Discord, Telegram, Slack Chat channel transports
Docker Docker execution for shell commands
Microsoft MXC Native operating-system containment for shell commands
ElevenLabs, OpenAI Cloud speech recognition and synthesis
Foundry Local Microsoft Foundry Local model discovery and inference
LLamaSharp Local GGUF inference
Local Speech Recognition Offline Whisper recognition
Local Speech Synthesis Offline Kokoro synthesis
Google Workspace Gmail, Google Calendar and YouTube tools
Microsoft Graph Outlook mail and Microsoft To Do tools
Web Web and news search

Build a .NET plugin

Plugins are NuGet packages that Oscova installs, enables and loads at runtime.

  • Start from the Echo sample plugin, the smallest complete plugin.
  • Follow Build your first plugin in the developer guide.
  • Preview plugin settings components with the settings preview sample.

Build from source

Plugins compile against the Oscova.Agents package at the exact version in Versions.props. Between releases main carries a development version such as 5.2.0-dev.1, so pack the framework locally first:

dotnet pack src/Oscova.Agents -c Release -o artifacts/nuget
dotnet build Oscova.Agents.sln -c Release -p:RestoreAdditionalProjectSources="$(pwd)/artifacts/nuget"

On Windows, clone into a short path such as C:\src or enable long paths, because the build passes the 260-character path limit otherwise.

To build the latest release instead, check out its tag, for example git checkout v3.4.1.

To build and run the full app, check out the app branch (git checkout app). After the build, start it from the checkout and open http://localhost:11317:

dotnet run --project src/App/Oscova.Agents.Host --launch-profile http

Report a bug or request a feature

Open a new issue and choose Bug report or Feature request. Each form asks for what we need, such as your Oscova version (oscova version), operating system and the steps to reproduce. Bugs and ideas for the application, CLI and Avatar Engine are welcome here too.

Pull requests are accepted from collaborators only. See CONTRIBUTING.md. If you would like to suggest a change, open an issue to discuss it first.

Security

Please report vulnerabilities privately. See SECURITY.md.

License

The framework and plugins are licensed under Apache-2.0. The app, published under src/App/ on the app branch, is licensed under AGPL-3.0 with a plugin exception: plugins built only against the Apache-2.0 framework are not covered by the AGPL. The official build uses a proprietary theme that is not included in this repository. The Oscova Avatar Engine is distributed separately as a free binary.

The official Oscova.Agents.App NuGet packages ship under their EULA.txt until their version's source is published on the app branch. From then on, src/App/LICENSE applies.

What is Oscova Agents?

Oscova Agents is a private AI agent OS: your agents' chats, memory, instructions and settings are encrypted under a Vault Password only you hold. An Egress Audit shows every call that leaves your machine. It runs on hardware you own, at home or in the office, with local models such as Ollama. On Windows, the free Oscova Avatar Engine app gives your agent a realistic 3D avatar that speaks on your screen.

Agents run as durable services. They keep working on scheduled tasks while you sleep and answer from any browser on your network.

  • A realistic 3D face for any agent. The Oscova Avatar Engine is a free Windows app that renders the avatar on your own PC and speaks your agent's replies with lip sync. Give OpenClaw, Hermes Agent or any MCP agent a 3D avatar.
  • Confidential by design. Every agent's chats, tool calls, task runs and memory are encrypted on disk under your Vault Password. Incognito chats never touch disk.
  • 默认为本地。 Run local models such as Ollama, LLamaSharp and Foundry Local. Cloud providers are opt-in, and the Egress Audit lists every moment data left the machine.
  • 没有遥测。 Oscova sends no usage statistics and no crash reports.
  • Token-frugal. The runtime keeps prompts lean, so small local models still do real work.
  • Yours to edit. Every system and runtime instruction can be read and changed.
  • One box for the household or office. Each person gets their own sign-in, agents, tasks and conversations, with roles and per-agent tool control.

Install Oscova on Windows, macOS or Linux

Oscova runs on Windows, macOS and Linux and needs the .NET 10 SDK. The installer offers to install .NET 10 when it is needed. Automatic .NET setup on Linux currently supports Ubuntu 24.04.

Windows（PowerShell）

irm https://oscova.ai/install.ps1 | iex

macOS and Linux

curl -fsSL https://oscova.ai/install.sh | bash

Or install the oscova CLI directly with .NET:

dotnet tool install --global Oscova.Agents.App

Then start Oscova:

oscova start

The Avatar Engine currently runs on Windows. Install it with oscova avatar install. Update Oscova with dotnet tool update --global Oscova.Agents.App.

See the documentation for setup, agents, tasks, privacy and administration.

Build a .NET plugin

Plugins are NuGet packages that Oscova installs, enables and loads at runtime.

  • Start from the Echo sample plugin, the smallest complete plugin.
  • Follow Build your first plugin in the developer guide.
  • Preview plugin settings components with the settings preview sample.

从源代码构建

Plugins compile against the Oscova.Agents package at the exact version in Versions.props. Between releases main carries a development version such as 5.2.0-dev.1, so pack the framework locally first:

dotnet pack src/Oscova.Agents -c Release -o artifacts/nuget
dotnet build Oscova.Agents.sln -c Release -p:RestoreAdditionalProjectSources="$(pwd)/artifacts/nuget"

On Windows, clone into a short path such as C:\src or enable long paths, because the build passes the 260-character path limit otherwise.

To build the latest release instead, check out its tag, for example git checkout v3.4.1.

To build and run the full app, check out the app branch (git checkout app). After the build, start it from the checkout and open http://localhost:11317:

dotnet run --project src/App/Oscova.Agents.Host --launch-profile http

Report a bug or request a feature

Open a new issue and choose Bug report or Feature request. Each form asks for what we need, such as your Oscova version (oscova version), operating system and the steps to reproduce. Bugs and ideas for the application, CLI and Avatar Engine are welcome here too.

Pull requests are accepted from collaborators only. 请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md。 If you would like to suggest a change, open an issue to discuss it first.
